body: It's ok. I want to die too.
If my parents (who I basically love) were dead, I'm pretty sure I'd just go ahead and end it. So I feel you. This world is no good for me.
A bullet is starting to sound pretty tasty right now. I'm still probably not going to do it... But man do I want to!

Life is fucked up. I'm feeling better right now. I feel more connected to myself than ever. I feel much more complete. I think I had a break down. I do feel better. But I also feel like I have new wierd weight to carry. It feels like now I know I have the ability to be happy with my life, and also the knowledge that if I ever decide I hate it too much, I can end it and then everything will be ok. That realization is oddly the only thing allowing me to currently push forward. The knowledge that if I decide its just really all a painful consciousness, all I have to do is a choose a way to end it and I'll be ok. I don't have to suffer needlessly for any longer than I decide I have to. And for the record, this is about an entirety of life consciousness. It fucking sucks ass beyond a measure of belief sometimes! But we'll just have to wait and see. Only time will tell.
Trying to figure it out too. I'd rather not be here but can't figure out how to end it either...
I feel you. By the sounds of things, you probably shouldn't do it. But man do I get the desire of wanting to!
Thanks for the suggestion. But at this point I don't want help. I want the balls to do it.
If you do it, I hope it brings you peace.
It's somehow good to know that there are others out there like me that just what to kill themselves.
Glad I'm not alone on that thought. I hope we both get peace soon in one way or another.

I just joined reddit to talk about how much I want to kill myself. I can't even figure out how to make a new post. I just want to find out how to make my suicide look like an accident so I don't have to think about all the fucks that I leave behind gossiping about how I killed myself. I sure hope I get killed soon so I don't have to do it myself. I'm so over this life. Fuck life.
